title: Armor Causes Trampling
description: A little mod that makes wearing boots while walking cause farmland trampling.
body:
All this mod does is make it so that when you wear boots and walk on farmland, it has a chance to trample it. (Yeah, that's literally all it does.)

By default wearing leather boots or sneaking prevents trampling, but this can be disabled.

The chance to trample and other things are configurable.

This is my first mod outside of MCreator, I won't make any significant attempts to update it.
